notes: Migrated to the new layout (2026-11-11). The earlier new husband, Paul Langevin, left no stored symmetric question (his real wife is little known), and the old functional question was flagged (codex: an unscoped spouse relation does not make Pierre Curie's marriage false), so the edit now names Winston Churchill, who like Marie Curie married only once and whose wife Clementine is well known: related near asks his wife (symmetry with functional). Related far asks the husband's nationality (stored: "the French physicist Pierre Curie"). The derived questions use binding (first woman to win a Nobel Prize) and two compositions on Churchill's stored facts. The indeterminate question is the 1903 physics prize (shared by name or with "her husband"); w2 is lopsided (Churchill as a physics laureate) and kept unweighted (README, Decisions 4). The Chinese question now uses 居里夫人, the usual Chinese name (two models garbled 玛丽·居里 in the audit). Negation is asked as "Is it true that ... not ...". Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate.
